ideas: Solve for the combination asked, not each variable
Add a cyclic system all at once
Write every quantity in one variable
topic.name: Linear Equations & Systems

playbook.example: If $3x+2y=11$ and $x+4y=7$, adding gives $4x+6y=18$, so $2x+3y=9$ with no solving.
playbook.move: Solve for the combination asked, not each variable
playbook.when: The question wants $x+y$, $2a-b$ or a ratio, not the variables themselves.

playbook.move: Add a cyclic system all at once
playbook.when: Each equation is a rotation of the others.

playbook.example: Ann is $4$ years older than Ben, and in $6$ years their ages sum to $40$: $(b+10)+(b+6)=40$, so $b=12$.
playbook.move: Write every quantity in one variable
playbook.when: Ages, coins or prices tied together by fixed differences or ratios.

topic.summary: Translating words into equations and solving them cleanly.
topic.trap: Answering with $x$ when the question asked for $x+y$, or for the age "in $6$ years".
